name: Interest Protocol Univ3CollateralToken minter-wide position collateral
summary: Interest Protocol's Univ3CollateralToken on Optimism stored deposited Uniswap V3 positions per vault minter, and balanceOf(vault) valued that minter-wide list. The attacker minted 30 vaults, deposited one WETH/USDC.e position for one of them, and borrowed USDC and USDi from every vault against the same position, redeeming the USDi for USDC.e.
notes: Reset is the governance registerErc20 listing the token as VaultController collateral (65% LTV), 11 days after the proxy's creation; without it no vault counts the position. The relay and controller upgrade in that block share its timestamp; the later LTV cut to 30% only shrank the loss.

The attacker's 30 vaults were minted in its setup transaction 0xa22bf777 just before the anchor; campaign.mjs and the token's deposit history (six depositors since launch) show no other borrower using one position across several vaults.
Loss is what left USDi's reserves (loss.mjs, DefiLlama prices); the WETH/USDC.e position the attacker left as collateral is not subtracted.
